title: Range Sum Query Using a Fenwick Tree
description: Implement a Binary Indexed Tree (Fenwick Tree) supporting point updates and prefix sum queries. Operations: `UPDATE index val` (adds val to index, 1-based) and `QUERY l r` (sum from l to r).
input_format: First line contains `n` and `m`. Second line contains `n` integers. Following `m` lines contain commands.
output_format: Outputs of QUERY separated by space.

sample_tests.explanation: Sum of [1, 3] was 1+3+5=9. After adding 2 to index 3, sum becomes 11.

hints: Use `idx += idx & (-idx)` to update parents in the Fenwick tree.
Use `idx -= idx & (-idx)` to accumulate prefix sums.
Range sum `query(l, r) = query(r) - query(l - 1)` runs in O(log n).
